summary.text: Shawn Dygert represents Idaho House District 23, Seat B, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Melba as the legislator's city.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Dygert was born in Blackfoot, Idaho, and holds a bachelor's degree from Utah State University and a master's degree from the University of Idaho.
It says Dygert was a high school agriculture education teacher and FFA advisor for 35 years.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
